Original Requirements:
i want a visualize snake game

IMPORTANT: You must create a comprehensive README.md file explaining how to run and test the project.
Product Goals: Create a visually appealing and engaging snake game.
Provide a smooth and responsive gameplay experience.
Ensure the game is easy to run and test with clear instructions.
User Stories: As a player, I want to control the snake's movement using keyboard input.
As a player, I want to see the snake grow longer when it eats food.
As a player, I want the game to end when the snake collides with the wall or itself.
As a player, I want to see my score displayed during the game.
As a developer, I want clear instructions on how to run and test the game.
Competitive Analysis: Classic Snake Game (Nokia): Simple, pixelated graphics, basic gameplay.
Google Snake: Clean interface, customizable colors, varying speeds.
Snake.io: Multiplayer online snake game with power-ups.
Slither.io: Similar to Snake.io, focuses on multiplayer competition.
Coolmath Games Snake: Simple, browser-based snake game with different levels.
Python Arcade Library Snake Example: Basic implementation using the Arcade library.
Pygame Snake Example: Basic implementation using the Pygame library.

Requirement Analysis: The core requirement is to create a functional snake game with visualization. This includes snake movement, food generation, collision detection, and score tracking. A crucial aspect is the README.md file, which must provide clear and concise instructions for running and testing the game. The game should be easily understandable and playable.
UI Design draft: The UI will consist of a rectangular game board. The snake will be represented by a series of connected blocks. Food will be represented by a different colored block. The score will be displayed in a corner of the screen. The game will use a simple, clean aesthetic with clear visual cues.
